name: steerdown
description: Typed reading paths for Markdown judged at build time
author: Alper Halil

scripts.format: oxfmt src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
